tex_content.html:
Corollary
Source: topping:page-0047, topping:page-0048 ↗ topping-maxpr-scalar-lower-bound 1. ch3:2.7\group maximum-principle

Let $g(t)$ be a Ricci flow on a closed manifold for $t\in [0,T]$, and let $\alpha :=\inf R<0$ at $t=0$. Then \[ \frac{V(t)}{\left(1+\frac{2(-\alpha )}{n}t\right)^{\frac n2}} \] is weakly decreasing, and consequently \[ V(t)\leq V(0)\left(1+\frac{2(-\alpha )}{n}t\right)^{\frac n2}. \]

Proof

\sketch Differentiate the logarithm of the ratio. The result is

\[ \frac{\dd }{\dd t}\ln \! \left[ \frac{V(t)}{\left(1+\frac{2(-\alpha )}{n}t\right)^{\frac n2}} \right] =-\frac{1}{V}\int R\, \dd V +\frac{\alpha }{1+\frac{2(-\alpha )}{n}t}. \]

This is at most

\[ -\inf _{\M }R(t)+\frac{\alpha }{1-\frac{2\alpha }{n}t}\leq 0, \]

by Theorem 4.
